kan_identity_inversion.assumption: the KAN's two slack responses take the lowest |dhat| ranks with no other ties or zero responses (true exactly for EBM, SP and tie-free XGB scenarios; within 2.1e-3 for FTT and linear, whose slack responses are float noise); an estimate, not a measurement

KAN_row.reason: r16_kan_faith.py stores per-scenario summaries only (r16_kan_faith_rows.csv); no per-probe KAN responses dhat were written, so the slack-excluded KAN rho needs a KAN refit and probe-matrix evaluation (a model run).

displayed_contribution_ordering_0.01.reason: r19_disp.py stores per-scenario rho only; the per-feature displayed EBM contributions at the base point were not written, so the slack-excluded value needs an EBM refit and eval_terms (a model run).

probe_base_readings.population: applied probes of the deployed M+D arm (the slack plant's two pairs removed), the scenarios of Table IV
probe_base_readings.bases: own: the stored responses, each per unit of the probed plant's own rating (the probe step is a fixed fraction of that rating); common_first_order: both responses divided by that rating, the first-order value on a common power base (the model is not re-evaluated at an equal-MW step)
probe_base_readings.tables: loso_table: per (channel, plant) median analytic magnitude over the other scenarios; table_from_other_gfm_configurations: the same median over the scenarios of the other GFM configurations; beyond_the_loso_table: per scenario, the rank correlation of the analytic and the model magnitudes after each is reduced by its leave-one-out median for the same (channel, plant), a descriptive association
probe_base_readings.amber_null_failures_preview_null_protoco: the null of an earlier verification script (not included): per scenario, Pearson correlation of average ranks against 2000 permutations of the analytic ranks, numpy default_rng(42) drawn once for the own base and then the common base; fail = observed <= np.quantile(permuted, 0.95)

table_from_other_gfm_configurations_vs_a.missing_entries_handling: A probe whose (channel, plant) has no entry in the table built from the scenarios of the other GFM configurations is left out of its scenario's table correlation: cb_compare looks each probe up with dict.get (NaN when absent), counts the NaN lookups as table_entries_missing and rank-correlates the analytic magnitudes with the table entries over the scenario's remaining probes (cb_rho is NaN below three probes or for a constant vector, and the paired test then drops the scenario), while AMBER's correlation in the same comparison keeps all of the scenario's applied probes; here 56 probes in 29 of 236 scenarios are left out (their (channel, plant) occurs only in the scenario's own GFM configuration), 0 scenarios keep fewer than three probes, and 0 drop out of the paired test (n = 236).

unfaithful_tail_by_predicted_margin.null: r15_battery.task_C per-scenario permutation null as task_c_null: RandomState(42), 1000 permutations of |dhat|, fail = rho < q95, on each arm's applied probes (the slack plant's two pairs removed)
unfaithful_tail_by_predicted_margin.protocol: r19_trust.py: AUC of the failure labels with the predicted margin as the score (sklearn roc_auc_score); predicted-margin terciles by np.quantile at one and two thirds and np.digitize, the deepest the lowest

pooled_null.population: the deployed M+D arm's fine probe pairs, the 236 scenarios of Table IV; all: every converged pair (the slack plant's zero pairs included); excl: the applied probes (the slack plant's two pairs removed)
pooled_null.protocol: r13_battery.task4 fast path (pooled_null): per scenario the Spearman rho as the mean product of standardized ranks; the null of the median over the scenarios, 1000 permutations of the model's ranks within each scenario, RandomState(42), one permutation-major stream; q95 and q99 by np.percentile; p_observed = the share of the 1000 null medians at or above the observed median, resolution 1/1000 (0 means none of them)
